summary: Thin __thiscall wrapper around an input-state query. Copies the this pointer into a local, passes a dword field read at offset 0x13EC (this[1275]) as the handle, a constant zero, and a pointer to the local into sub_55C450, then returns the local (which aliases this). Acts as an adapter between the caller and the input-state query routine.

operations.description: Copy this into the stack local v2 so it can be passed by address.
Call sub_55C450 with the input-state handle read from this[1275] (offset 0x13EC), constant 0, and the address of v2.
Return v2, which still holds this after the query call.

unresolved: Meaning of the constant 0 argument to sub_55C450 is unknown.
Whether sub_55C450 writes through &v2 and can mutate the returned value is not established here.
Ownership and type of the object containing offset 0x13EC are unknown.
